title: Runner Hypertrophy 3D
author: Ilija Beljan
desc:
Hybrid Runner Hypertrophy 3D is a 3-day full-body program designed for recreational runners who want to build muscle while continuing to run 3–4 times per week.

The program prioritizes upper-body hypertrophy while keeping lower-body volume effective but manageable, helping reduce unnecessary fatigue around interval, tempo and long-run sessions.

Each workout combines compound lifts with targeted hypertrophy work and core training. Lower-body training is distributed across the week instead of being concentrated into one high-fatigue leg day. Hack squats provide the main bilateral quad stimulus, while Bulgarian split squats add unilateral work that complements running. Hamstring work is kept controlled and machine-based during this first block rather than relying on heavy hip-hinge training.

Most compound exercises are performed with 2–3 reps in reserve, while isolation exercises can be taken closer to failure. Progression is based on simple double progression: increase repetitions within the prescribed range before increasing load.

The program is designed to fit into approximately 60-minute sessions and works best alongside a running schedule that includes easy runs, one or two quality sessions, and a weekly long run.

Main goals:
• Build and maintain muscle while running regularly
• Improve upper-body size and strength
• Maintain useful lower-body strength without excessive soreness
• Include unilateral and core work relevant to runners
• Keep gym sessions efficient and sustainable
